credibility.description: The credibility of this statement, using the Admirality scale

description:
The impact assessment rates the potential severity at a level 7 on the 0‑to‑10 scale. The projected consequences include Disruption, Economic Advantage, Brand Damage and Denial and Deception. If the construct were realized, it would cause significant operational disruptions across supply chains, erode customer trust, and give competitors an economic edge through lost revenue and damaged brand perception.  

The credibility of this analysis is judged to be 5 on the Admirality scale.
